attempts.title: people_search returns full verbose profiles; truncate to only name+title before injecting into context

hypothesis.title: people_search returns full verbose profiles; truncate to only name+title before injecting into context
hypothesis.root_cause: The `people_search` tool returns full LinkedIn-style profiles from `_full_profile()` in the backend, including skills, all_employers, education, recent_posts, summary, etc. For the postman task this produces 51,523 chars / ~12,800 tokens of tool output injected into the conversation, blowing the 8,000-token budget. The agent only needs name and title from each person.
evidence: task `postman` step 3: people_search returned 51523 chars, prompt=12349tok, total=14104 tokens vs budget 8000
scout/tools.py:68 people_search returns raw backend output with no trimming
scout/backends.py _full_profile builds rich profiles with skills(20), all_employers(5), recent_posts(3), long summaries — all irrelevant to the brief
hypothesis.expected_effect: task `postman` should flip from failed to passed on `within_token_budget`. Token count should drop from ~14,104 to well under 8,000. No other tasks should regress since they all use the same tool and will also benefit from smaller context.
